# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Phillips maintains poor discipline in his schoolroom, frequently resorting to whipping his pupils yet keeping no order at all. He shows partiality toward his older students while neglecting the younger ones, and he displays a solemn, self-righteous attitude when reprimanding students for bad behavior.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Traits

- unable to maintain discipline  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- frequently uses whipping as punishment  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- shows partiality toward older scholars  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Goals

- prepare older scholars for Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips taught at the Avonlea school, where he boarded at Eben Wright's house. During his time as master, he was known for spending most of his attention preparing his older students for Queen's and neglecting the younger pupils. On one occasion, he embarrassed Anne Shirley on her first day by holding up her marked slate before the class, and later made her stand on the platform by the blackboard after a fit of temper. He also got into a dispute with Sam Boulter's father after whipping Sam for talk in class. Mr. Phillips spent considerable time courting Prissy Andrews, hearing her Latin lessons in the back of the room and giving her Mayflowers.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)_
